g.text: Reproduction threshold changes early births and finite-horizon survival
All 40 worlds shown. Founder/RNG states match by seed; food maps match within each layout.
Triangles are right-censored observations, not extinction times. Bottom lines pair seeds; they do not show time trajectories.
Twenty high-threshold survivors do not prove permanent stability or identify a unique causal mechanism.
